items.reason: The claimed count on every anonymous request is prevented by the device cache: pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/impl.go:83 returns before calling CreateOrUpdateDevice on cache hits, with a 29-minute expiration configured at impl.go:42. The new count at pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go:110 therefore runs only for uncached devices when a positive limit is configured.

The new updateDevice callback mutates captured args by prepending query on every invocation at pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go:84. WithDbSession enables callback retries at pkg/services/sqlstore/session.go:127, and retryOnLocks invokes that same callback again after SQLite lock errors at session.go:90–102; when retries are configured, subsequent attempts receive an extra SQL string as a bound argument and fail.
